topic_description: This cluster of papers focuses on sentiment analysis and opinion mining, particularly in the context of social media and text mining. It covers various techniques such as lexicon-based methods, deep learning, aspect-based sentiment analysis, and machine learning for analyzing emotions and opinions in textual data from platforms like Twitter. The research also delves into emotion recognition and the impact of sentiment analysis on public perception.
